scripts.build: echo '🏗️ Building Core Packages...' && echo '➤ i18n' && (cd packages/i18n && bun run build) && echo '➤ Parser' && (cd packages/parser && bun run build) && echo '➤ Compiler' && (cd packages/compiler && bun run build) && echo '➤ Analyzer' && (cd packages/analyzer && bun run build) && echo '➤ Renderer' && (cd packages/renderer && bun run build) && echo '✅ Core build complete.'
scripts.build:playground: echo '🎨 Building Playground...' && (cd packages/playground && bun run build) && echo '✅ Playground build complete.'
scripts.dev: echo '🚀 Starting Playground...' && (cd packages/playground && bun run start)
